notes.title: Online Multiplayer Update
notes.content:
I have re-coded the project from scratch to add online play to Wizard Bros. So you can now play the game with friends Online as well as locally as before.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/IndolentLeftEmeraldtreeskink-size_restricted.gif[/img]

notes.title: Pacth 1.1.7.6
notes.content:
[b]Improvement[/b]
[list]
[*]Tutorial can now be play be played with multiple players
[*]Added a section for power ups in the tutorial level
[*]When in snow man mode player was only destroyed is fire was thrown at them. Now all fire destroys it to balance things out.
[/list]
[b]Bugs fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed - Player would go to next level with holding animation while holding nothing. Issue is fixed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.7.4 (New level and New Power up)
notes.content:
Adding a [b]Brand New Level[/b] to the Dungeon environment. 

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ShamefulIncompleteElephantseal-size_restricted.gif[/img]

Also now you can play as the [b]Snow Man[/b] by picking up the ice power up that spawns in the level. The snow man can throw snow balls and is not affected by traps but can be destroyed if fire is thrown at it.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/HappyDeepAmethystinepython-size_restricted.gif[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.7.2 (New magical trap and other improvements)
notes.content:
[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/ClumsyAdoredCicada-size_restricted.gif[/img]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] A new trap which send out a homing magical projectile towards the players. 
[*] Adding spikes to the rotating trap.
[*] Changes to the layout of the newly added levels.
[*] Reducing Rotating trap speed and minor other adjustments
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed - Trap rotation speed was dependent on computer frame rate. Now they are frame independent.
[*] Fixed - Traps would continue to go after the players after round was finished. Now they stop.
[/list]

notes.title: New Environment Update
notes.content:
Introducing a new environment with new traps to the game. The new environment has two levels at the moment. More levels will be added to the new environment in the coming updates.

[img]https://thumbs.gfycat.com/GranularFoolishGroundbeetle-size_restricted.gif[/img]

There are also a bunch of minor changes and bug fixes:

[b]New Features[/b]
- Updated player select menu
- Player fire won't block projectiles anymore

[b]Bugs[/b]
Fixed - Player getting stuck in the floor on respawn
Fixed - Key getting destroyed when hit by projectile

notes.title: Major Update: 4 Players co op support
notes.content:
Here comes our first major update. Wizard Bros now supports up to 4 players local co op gameplay. 

This feature has just been implemented so there might be bugs despite my best efforts to make sure everything works. So please drop a message in the discussions or email me at so I can fix them. Last note on the 4 player feature when playing online using "remote play together" is that all players in to select the player 1 uses controller option when starting the game

There are also a bunch of minor changes and bug fixes:

[b]New Features[/b]
- Removed slow motion effect on hit
- Added screen shake when breaking ice
- Ability for the first player to play with the keyboard and mouse
- Key will not turn to ice if lost

[b]Bugs[/b]
Fixed - Loser player keys where not reset when a new level was started. Now all players keys are reset to 0 at the start of each level.
Fixed - Key dropping down through the floor in endless loop.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7.2
notes.content:
Here is the second patch that addresses some more pesky bugs. Feel free to tell me about any bugs or features you would like to see in the game and you will give you credit for it the upcoming announcements :)

Fixed - Issue with audio settings where music would not stop even though the volume was set to 0 (Reported by RevengeFromMars)

Fixed - Issue in tutorial mode where the key could be thrown out of level and never recovered. Now keys that are thrown out should respawn.

Fixed - Issue in tutorial mode where player carrying their fire through portals.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7.0 - First Patch
notes.content:
Here comes the first ever patch for Wizard Bros to fix some reported bugs.

Fixed - Player falling down in the beginning of the level. 

Fixed - Players jumping over level with number keys. This was a feature that I was using during development that I had forgotten to take. But it is out now.
